Mignarda wrote:

>The thing that really ices it for me is that Ted's personality and his
>motivation for killing are exactly the same as Zodiac's--he's just the sort
>of personality you'd expect Zodiac to be, murdering to make a statement and
>to get publicity. Time will tell.

Not really.  The Unabomber has always held intellectual pretensions and has
used his anti-technology views as a front for what was essentially a
sociopathic outburst.  The Zodiac, on the other hand, has never openly given
his political or philosophical views; on one letter to the SFPD he stated he
wanted vengeance for having been rejected by so many females in high school,
etc.  I don't recall any stories of TK asking out any girls in HS.  Moreover,
the Zodiac faced his victims up close, whereas TK sent mailbombs.  IIRC, in his
letters the Zodiac killer even made references to drugs; TK is not known to
have used drugs, as far as I know.
